query: 1973 年 SOSP 首次 UNIX 论文报告
quote: Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie presented the first Unix paper at the Symposium on Operating Systems Principles at Purdue University in November 1973.

query: Fabry 在会与求取系统的动因
quote: Professor Bob Fabry, of the University of California at Berkeley, was in attendance and immediately became interested in obtaining a copy of the system to experiment with at Berkeley.

query: 会议之外的技术介入：远程调试（可证范围）
quote: Because Berkeley had only a 300-baud acoustic-coupled modem without auto answer capability, Thompson would call Standiford in the machine room and have him insert the phone into the modem; in this way Thompson was able to remotely debug crash dumps from New Jersey.

query: 双方意向契合：实验室乐于共享、伯克利急需改进
quote: The willingness of the researchers at the Labs to share their work with Berkeley was instrumental in the rapid improvement of the software available at Berkeley.

query: 当事人回忆中的细节（一手材料的构成）
quote: Because Berkeley had only a 300-baud acoustic-coupled modem without auto answer capability, Thompson would call Standiford in the machine room and have him insert the phone into the modem; in this way Thompson was able to remotely debug crash dumps from New Jersey.

query: 接触之后的次第：先购机、后装系统
quote: At the time, Berkeley had only large mainframe computer systems doing batch processing, so the first order of business was to get a PDP-11/45 suitable for running with the then-current Version 4 of Unix.

query: 两步授权路径：先购 AT&T 许可、再向 UCB 订磁带
quote: A customer purchased Unix from AT&T and then ordered a BSD tape from UCB.

query: 1974 年 1 月 V4 磁带交付
quote: In January 1974, a Version 4 tape was delivered and Unix was installed by graduate student Keith Standiford.

query: 三部合购机型：取得过程的前置事实
quote: The Computer Science Department at Berkeley, together with the Mathematics Department and the Statistics Department, were able to jointly purchase a PDP-11/45.

query: AT&T 源码许可为分发前置（许可框架约束）
quote: Up through the release of 4.3BSD-Tahoe, all recipients of BSD had to first get an AT&T source license.

query: 到货后运行期的磁盘控制器问题
quote: Many of the crashes were caused by the disk controller's inability to reliably do overlapped seeks, contrary to the documentation.

query: 双盘共控制器的机型条件（复原记录可互证）
quote: Berkeley's 11/45 was among the first systems that Thompson had encountered that had two disks on the same controller!

query: 装机后系统可用：与 RSTS 共用机时
quote: Though Unix was soon reliably up and running, the coalition of Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics began to run into problems; Math and Statistics wanted to run DEC's RSTS system.

query: 维基佐证：PDP-11/45 为运行 UNIX 而购置
quote: A PDP-11/45 was purchased to run Unix.

query: 八小时轮班：机时分配的早期安排
quote: After much debate, a compromise was reached in which each department would get an eight-hour shift; Unix would run for eight hours followed by sixteen hours of RSTS.

query: 课程学生选择 UNIX 作项目（环境雏形）
quote: Despite the bizarre schedule, students taking the Operating Systems course preferred to do their projects on Unix rather than on the batch machine.

query: INGRES 课题组由批处理转入交互环境
quote: Professors Eugene Wong and Michael Stonebraker were both stymied by the confinements of the batch environment, so their INGRES database project was among the first groups to move from the batch machines to the interactive environment provided by Unix.
They quickly found the shortage of machine time and the odd hours on the 11/45 intolerable, so in the spring of 1974, they purchased an 11/40 running the newly available Version 5.

query: INGRES 磁带外发：环境叙述的档案支撑
quote: Several hundred INGRES tapes were shipped over the next six years, helping to establish Berkeley's reputation for designing and building real systems.
